2026-11-19T11:50:33.3125509Z   
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3127072Z   **New networks** (both have no typical price yet, because no source I'm allowed to read gives one):
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3131046Z   - **Exploren** also covers **Engie**: Exploren's parent company bought Engie's Australian chargers in 2025 and moved them into the Exploren app. Its site is set to `forbidden`, since we may not read Exploren's own website.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3135970Z   - **Wevolt** also covers **Electrona**, whose Tasmanian chargers take a card or the Wevolt app. Its site is set to `unchecked`: Wevolt's robots.txt blocks AI training crawlers, and I didn't read its terms.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3139024Z   
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3139953Z   **Added to existing networks:**
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3143047Z   - **Chargefox:** Yurika and the Queensland Electric Super Highway (49 and 6 sites), RAA, Electric Highway Tasmania, the WA EV Network and Horizon Power's EV Highway, and Woolworths. Each is paid through Chargefox's app.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3146416Z   - **Evie:** Charging the Regions, whose chargers Evie runs.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3147774Z   
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3148788Z   **Prices:**
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3151099Z   - I found nothing I'm allowed to use that shows a new typical price. The Evie FAQ gives only cost per full charge, and the NRMA and Horizon Power pages refused to load.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3154480Z   - Every `checked` date is 2026-10-27, under six months old, so I opened no issue asking you to check prices in the apps.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3156459Z   
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3157401Z   **Things to check before merging:**
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3159800Z   - **`raa` is a short match.** Any site name containing "raa" would get Chargefox's price. I couldn't search the charger file to rule that out.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3163848Z   - **`woolworths`** could catch another network's charger in a Woolworths car park, for example an Evie site named after the store.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3166947Z   - **Charging the Regions:** a few of Wellington Shire's sites use Chargefox rather than Evie, so they'd get Evie's price.
2026-11-19T11:50:33.3170495Z   - **WA EV Network price:** its fees ($0.60/kWh at fast chargers, the same as Chargefox's typical price) came from a search result, not the Horizon Power page itself.
